description: **docs/CONSUMING_OPTIONS.md gives a two-step decisions move that `policy` refuses.** A pull request is judged with its base's rules, and a consumer's `meta` globs do not match `registries/decisions/*` until they are merged, so the first step must add only the glob: three steps. Napoleon J105 follows the corrected order. Raised: J78 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: CONSUMING_OPTIONS: the decisions move needs a glob-only first pull request
